annotation.title_clean: Statement of the Commission on the updated Legislative Financial Statement of the Cyber Solidarity Act (Digital Europe Programme reallocations)
annotation.title_en: Statement of the Commission on the updated Legislative Financial Statement of the Cyber Solidarity Act (Digital Europe Programme reallocations)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, Series C
annotation.summary_en: European Commission statement in the Official Journal updating the Legislative Financial Statement of the Cyber Solidarity Act. It sets 2025-2027 Digital Europe Programme envelopes after reallocations among the AI, Cybersecurity and Trust, and Advanced Digital Skills objectives, and funds the EU Cybersecurity Reserve from the Commission-managed cybersecurity envelope.
key_provisions_or_claims: Co-legislators agreed on 5 March 2024 to limit reallocation from Advanced Digital Skills to Cybersecurity and Trust to EUR 22 million.
Cybersecurity and Trust: EUR 44,451,000 under direct Commission management and EUR 353,190,613 under the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre.
EU Cybersecurity Reserve funded from the Commission-managed cybersecurity envelope.
